verification.subject: Verify your KAMBRIQ email
verification.heading: Welcome, {firstName}!
verification.body: Thanks for joining KAMBRIQ. Please verify your email address to get started.
verification.expiry: This link expires in 24 hours. If the button doesn't work, copy this URL into your browser:

passwordReset.subject: Reset your KAMBRIQ password
passwordReset.heading: Password Reset
passwordReset.body: Hi {firstName}, we received a request to reset your password.
passwordReset.expiry: This link expires in 1 hour. If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email - your password won't change.

passwordResetConfirmation.subject: Your KAMBRIQ password has been reset
passwordResetConfirmation.heading: Password Changed
passwordResetConfirmation.body: Hi {firstName}, your password has been successfully reset.
passwordResetConfirmation.warning: If you didn't make this change, please contact our support team immediately.

accountReactivated.subject: Welcome back to KAMBRIQ!
accountReactivated.heading: Account Reactivated
accountReactivated.body: Hi {firstName}, great to have you back! Your KAMBRIQ account has been successfully reactivated.
accountReactivated.note: All your data is intact and ready for you.

accountBlocked.subject: Your KAMBRIQ account has been suspended
accountBlocked.heading: Account Suspended
accountBlocked.body: Hi {firstName}, your KAMBRIQ account has been suspended by an administrator.
accountBlocked.note: If you believe this was done in error, please contact our support team for assistance.

accountUnblocked.subject: Your KAMBRIQ account has been reactivated
accountUnblocked.heading: Account Reactivated
accountUnblocked.body: Hi {firstName}, your KAMBRIQ account has been reactivated by an administrator. You can now log in again.

accountDeletion.subject: Your KAMBRIQ account has been scheduled for deletion
accountDeletion.heading: Account Deletion Scheduled
accountDeletion.body: Hi {firstName}, as requested, your KAMBRIQ account has been deactivated.
accountDeletion.grace: You have {days} days to change your mind. Simply log in to reactivate your account.
accountDeletion.warning: After the grace period, your account and data will be permanently deleted.

examPassed.subject: 🎉 Congratulations! You passed the KBS exam
examPassed.heading: Exam Passed!
examPassed.body: Hi {firstName}, congratulations! You scored {score}% on the KBS certification exam (passing score: {passingScore}%).
examPassed.note: You are now eligible for KCA certification. An admin will review and issue your certificate shortly.

examFailed.subject: KBS Exam Results
examFailed.heading: Exam Results
examFailed.body: Hi {firstName}, unfortunately you scored {score}% on the KBS exam (passing score: {passingScore}%).
examFailed.retake: You have {attemptsRemaining} attempt(s) remaining. You can retake the exam after {retakeDate}.
examFailed.encouragement: We recommend reviewing the module materials before your next attempt. You've got this!

certificateIssued.subject: 🏆 Your KCA Certificate is ready!
certificateIssued.heading: KCA Certificate Issued
certificateIssued.body: Hi {firstName}, your KAMBRIQ Certified Agent certificate has been issued!
certificateIssued.note: You can now apply to join KAMNET and start your journey as a KAMBRIQ agent.

applicationSubmitted.subject: KAMNET Application Received
applicationSubmitted.heading: Application Submitted
applicationSubmitted.body: Hi {firstName}, we've received your application to join the KAMNET agent network.
applicationSubmitted.note: Our team will review your application shortly. You'll receive an email once a decision has been made.

applicationApproved.subject: 🎉 Welcome to KAMNET!
applicationApproved.heading: Application Approved
applicationApproved.body: Hi {firstName}, great news! Your KAMNET application has been approved.
applicationApproved.note: You can now access the agent dashboard, browse land listings, and start your KAMBRIQ journey.

applicationRejected.subject: KAMNET Application Update
applicationRejected.heading: Application Update
applicationRejected.body: Hi {firstName}, after review, your KAMNET application could not be approved at this time.
applicationRejected.note: If you believe this was an error, please contact our support team.

agentSuspended.subject: Your KAMNET Agent Account has been suspended
agentSuspended.heading: Account Suspended
agentSuspended.body: Hi {firstName}, your KAMNET agent account has been suspended.
agentSuspended.note: Please contact the KAMNET administration for more information.

agentReactivated.subject: Your KAMNET Agent Account has been reactivated
agentReactivated.heading: Agent Account Reactivated
agentReactivated.body: Hi {firstName}, your KAMNET agent account has been reactivated. You can now access all agent features again.

agentPromotion.subject: 🎉 You've been promoted on KAMNET!
agentPromotion.heading: Congratulations, {firstName}!
agentPromotion.body: Your hard work is paying off - you've earned a promotion on the KAMNET network.
agentPromotion.note: Keep growing your network and closing sales. The next level is within reach.

emailChangeRequest.subject: Confirm your new KAMBRIQ email address
emailChangeRequest.heading: Email Address Change
emailChangeRequest.body: Hi {firstName}, you requested to change your email address to {newEmail}. Click below to confirm.
emailChangeRequest.expiry: This link expires in 24 hours. If you didn't request this, ignore this email - your current address remains unchanged.

emailChangeConfirm.subject: Your KAMBRIQ email address has been updated
emailChangeConfirm.heading: Email Address Updated
emailChangeConfirm.body: Hi {firstName}, your KAMBRIQ email address has been changed to {newEmail}.
emailChangeConfirm.warning: If you didn't make this change, please contact our support team immediately.

idVerified.subject: Your identity has been verified
idVerified.heading: Identity Verified ✓
idVerified.body: Hi {firstName}, your identity document has been reviewed and approved.

idRejected.subject: Identity verification - action required
idRejected.heading: Document Not Accepted
idRejected.body: Hi {firstName}, we were unable to verify your identity document.
idRejected.retry: Please submit a new valid document from your account settings.

inviteUser.subject: Welcome to KAMBRIQ - Set your password
inviteUser.heading: Welcome, {firstName}!
inviteUser.body: A KAMBRIQ account has been created for you. Set your password to get started.
inviteUser.expiry: This link expires in 24 hours. If you didn't request this account, you can safely ignore this email.

kbsEnrollmentReceived.subject: Your KBS application has been received
kbsEnrollmentReceived.heading: Application received
kbsEnrollmentReceived.body: Hi {firstName}, we have received your application to the KBS (Kambriq Business School) training program.
kbsEnrollmentReceived.paymentIntro: To finalize your registration, please proceed with the training fee payment:
kbsEnrollmentReceived.instructions: Payment instructions will be sent to you by our team. Please contact us at contact@kambriq.com to receive the details.
kbsEnrollmentReceived.note: Once payment is received, your application will be validated within 48 business hours and you will be able to access your training path.

reservationCreated.subject: New reservation created
reservationCreated.heading: Reservation confirmed on your side
reservationCreated.body: Hi {firstName}, you just reserved a land for {clientName}.
reservationCreated.note: The client has been notified and will receive their portal access shortly.

clientPortalAccess.subject: Welcome to your KAMBRIQ client portal
clientPortalAccess.heading: Welcome to KAMBRIQ
clientPortalAccess.body: Hi {clientName}, your reservation has been opened and a client portal has been set up for you.
clientPortalAccess.note: You can track every step of your acquisition from your portal.

reservationConfirmed.subject: Your down payment has been received
reservationConfirmed.heading: Down payment confirmed
reservationConfirmed.body: Hi {firstName}, the down payment for your reservation {reservationId} has been received and validated.
reservationConfirmed.note: We will keep you informed as your file progresses.

reservationCancelled.subject: Your reservation has been cancelled
reservationCancelled.heading: Reservation cancelled
reservationCancelled.body: Hi {firstName}, your reservation on {landTitle} has been cancelled.
reservationCancelled.note: If you have any questions, please contact your KAMNET agent.

clientDocumentUploaded.subject: New client document uploaded
clientDocumentUploaded.heading: A client document was uploaded
clientDocumentUploaded.body: Hi {firstName}, your client {clientName} just uploaded a {docType} document for the reservation on {landTitle}.
clientDocumentUploaded.note: Please review and approve the documents in the admin dashboard once the file is complete.

clientDocumentRejected.subject: Your document was not accepted
clientDocumentRejected.heading: Document rejected
clientDocumentRejected.body: Hi {clientName}, we were unable to validate your {docType} for the reservation on {landTitle}.
clientDocumentRejected.retry: Please log in to your portal and upload a new document.

clientDocumentsValidated.subject: Your documents have been validated
clientDocumentsValidated.heading: Documents validated
clientDocumentsValidated.body: Hi {clientName}, your documents for the reservation on {landTitle} have been reviewed and validated by KAMBRIQ.
clientDocumentsValidated.note: We are now waiting for the final payment to proceed to the next step.

paymentConfirmed.subject: Payment received
paymentConfirmed.heading: Final payment confirmed
paymentConfirmed.body: Hi {clientName}, your remaining payment for the reservation on {landTitle} has been received.
paymentConfirmed.note: Your file will now move to title transfer.

dossierStarted.subject: Your title transfer has started
dossierStarted.heading: Title transfer in progress
dossierStarted.body: Hi {clientName}, the title transfer for your land {landTitle} has officially started.
dossierStarted.note: Final documents will be delivered to you once the transfer is complete.

footer.ignore: If you didn't request this email, you can safely ignore it.

paymentInstructions.subject: Your KAMBRIQ payment reference: {reference}
paymentInstructions.heading: Payment instructions
paymentInstructions.intro: Hello {clientName}, here is everything needed to pay for {subject}.
paymentInstructions.referenceRule: This reference must appear as the motif of the transfer, the mobile money payment or the notary's receipt. A payment without it cannot be matched to your file.
paymentInstructions.notaryHeading: 3. Cash or deed at the notary
paymentInstructions.forwarding: You can forward this message as it is to whoever makes the payment for you. Everything they need is in it.
paymentInstructions.afterPaying: Once you have paid, keep the receipt: you will be asked for it. KAMBRIQ checks every payment before validating it, which can take a few working days.
paymentInstructions.supportBody: Write to {supportEmail} or call {supportPhone}, quoting the reference above.

paymentReminder.subject: Reminder: payment {reference} due by {deadline}
paymentReminder.subjectOverdue: Reminder: payment {reference} — past its due date
paymentReminder.heading: Payment reminder
paymentReminder.introUpcoming: Hello {clientName}, the deadline for paying {subject} is approaching: it is {deadline}.
paymentReminder.introOverdue: Hello {clientName}, the deadline of {deadline} for paying {subject} has passed and we have not yet recorded your payment.
paymentReminder.crossed: If you have already paid, this message simply crossed your transfer — there is nothing to do, the payment will be attached to your file as soon as it reaches us.
paymentReminder.instructionsAgain: Your payment details remain available in your account, behind your sign-in.

paymentInstructionsAvailable.subject: Your payment details are ready: {reference}
paymentInstructionsAvailable.heading: Your payment details are ready
paymentInstructionsAvailable.intro: Hello {clientName}, we have prepared the details for paying {subject}. They are waiting on your account, once you sign in.
paymentInstructionsAvailable.why: They are not in this email: bank details should not travel in a mailbox that can be forwarded. On your account they sit next to your payment, and you can come back to them at any time.

contactRequestReceived.subject: We have your message - KAMBRIQ
contactRequestReceived.heading: Your message arrived
contactRequestReceived.intro: Hello {name}, we have your enquiry and somebody from the team will reply within 24 working hours.
contactRequestReceived.referenceRule: Keep it: it lets us find your message if you call us back.
contactRequestReceived.closing: If your request is urgent, you can reply directly to this email.

contactRequestNotification.subject: New contact request - {subject}
contactRequestNotification.heading: A new contact request has arrived

contactDigest.subject: Contact requests: {count} over 48 h
contactDigest.heading: Daily contact request digest
contactDigest.intro: Over the last 48 hours ({since} - {until}), {count} contact request(s) came in.
contactDigest.zeroNote: No requests in the period. This digest goes out every day, zero included: if it stops arriving, that is the signal.
